source_read: Belhaven pub menus: every /pubs/<area>/<pub>/menu page in https://www.belhaven.co.uk/sitemap.xml (94) and the getmenus feed each page loads (https://www.belhaven.co.uk/api/menus/getmenus/<venue id>); 94 feeds read on 2026-10-12 (62 list menus), combined sha256 fd0874312d03982703e3cff074f13312ac45e0b4c9ef1b90816726e47680cf4b; robots.txt of www.belhaven.co.uk disallows /sitecore/, /media/, /images/, /js/ and similar, not /pubs/ or /api/menus/ (the site had answered Akamai 403 on 2026-10-09/10; it answered 200 throughout this read)
not_verifiable: allergens (Smart Chef, robots.txt Disallow: /: link only); which pubs serve each format beyond the feeds read
notes: Independent check, by a different method: seven pubs' menu pages rendered in headless Chromium as a visitor sees them, each of their menus opened with the page's own switch (?type=...): White Cart (8 menus incl. ciabattas, bar snacks, kids' plus, no-gluten, Sunday), Doctors (5), Granary Moray (seniors', main), Picture House Lanarkshire (Sunday roasts), Maltman (kids', lunch), Quaich (pizza), Compass (main); 313 (dish name, 'NNN kcal') pairs read from the page text. 162 of the 171 published items appear on those pages with the same calories (161 by the automatic pass, Vegan Ice Cream on the seniors' menu by hand); the other 9 are on menus or sections none of those pubs carries (the grills section at 5 pubs: 8oz Rump, 10oz Rib Eye, 7oz Fillet, Chicken Fajitas; the starters version of Crispy Squid; Crispy Halloumi Bites; Classic Mac and Cheese; the desserts-menu Vegan Ice Cream; 1 Scoop of Vegan Ice Cream) and rest on the feeds' internal agreement. Internal check: each product (by the feed's own product id) prints one figure at every pub listing it (0 differ); 17 printed at one pub only are left out. Fixed in the script: the no-gluten sections of the lunch and Sunday menus had been filed with the ordinary sections, which made their versions look like conflicts (now their own sections, labelled no-gluten); one name with two figures on menus of one kind and in one section is now left out (Balmoral Burger 1,562/1,771, Balmoral Chicken, Sausage and Mash, Garlic Ciabatta, Cheesy Garlic Ciabatta, Onion Rings, Triple Chocolate Brownie, Sticky Toffee Pudding 802/480). Left out: 268 alcoholic drink rows (40 drinks), 152 rows with no calories, 51 '... of the Day' rows.
